name: Public API Entry Points
description: Barrel modules exposing the package's two entry points: the main React-plus-core export and the React-free `/core` subpath.

name: React Bindings
description: SocketProvider context and hooks (global, local, event, send, state) that bind logical connections to React 18+ component lifecycles via external stores.

name: Core Connection Runtime
description: Framework-agnostic logical connection state machine, replaceable native WebSocket transport with heartbeat, and backoff utilities that drive reconnection.

name: Core Contracts
description: Typed connection definitions, options with validation and serialization, connection state models, and reconnection policy types shared by every other layer.

name: Test Suite
description: Vitest suites covering core reconnection behavior, React hooks, and compile-time protocol typing, backed by a MockWebSocket helper.

name: Build & Tooling Configuration
description: Package manifest, TypeScript project configs, Vite library/test build, ESLint rules, and npm publishing settings.

name: Documentation
description: README with overview, API reference and migration guide, plus the project license.
